about_the_game:
Relive the early days of Sofia’s Dark Fantasies with this Sofia's Dark Fantasies Art Collection of 110 wallpapers From our Early days to before the steam Release, offered completely free as a thank-you to the community.

These images come from the project’s earliest builds — before the polished Reimagined Episode 1 — and show Sofia across a variety of moods and styles:

Every wallpaper has been exported in 4K.

⚠️ Please note: this is a Legacy / Archive pack. These images are non-canon, behind-the-scenes art and do not represent the current visual style of the main story.

Adult Content Disclaimer:
This DLC contains a handful of tasteful of images that contain nudity. No explicit sexual acts are depicted.

And yes — it’s completely free. Thank you for supporting Sofia’s Dark Fantasies as the journey continues with Episode 2 and beyond.

Sofia’s Dark Fantasies – Art Collection 

This free collection includes ~110 curated high-resolution wallpapers from the early development of Sofia’s Dark Fantasies.
Showcasing office glamour, nightlife, luxury shots, superhero experiments, and cut Episode 2 concepts, this pack offers a unique behind-the-scenes look at Sofia’s journey.

Perfect for fans who want to explore the project’s roots and enjoy Sofia outside the main story.

How to access your wallpapers:

  • Right-click on Sofia’s Dark Fantasies in your Steam Library.

  • Select Properties.

  • Go to Installed Files.

  • Click Browse.

  • Unzip the Extras.zip file and enjoy

content_descriptors.notes:
Wallpapers from Sofia Dark Fantasy focuses on Sofia's story, from fantasies that happen in her imagination to reality, all the content is consensual sex, Sofia's uses an APP called the Veil App to plan her fantasies in real life, there's no abuse, drugs, alcohol or any self harm.

The does feature sex scenes, with blowjob, vaginal penetration and anal penetration but all based on Sofia's choices and her progression.
